name: M3_MMS200MI_CpyItmBasic
description: Create a new basic item master record by copying an existing item that has the same status. The operation searches existing items for the status you specify and uses the first matching item as a template. All basic attributes of the new item are taken from this template unless you override them through input fields. The result returns the created item number and the harvest method so that you can continue configuring planning and logistics settings for the item elsewhere.

inputParameters.name: STAT
inputParameters.description: Status used to select an existing item to copy and applied to the new item.

inputParameters.name: ITNO
inputParameters.description: Item number to be created in the item master.

inputParameters.name: CONO
inputParameters.description: Company in which the new item is created.

inputParameters.name: CITN
inputParameters.description: Item number to copy from; if not provided, the system selects the first item with the specified status.

inputParameters.name: ITDS
inputParameters.description: Primary item description to set for the new item.

inputParameters.name: FUDS
inputParameters.description: Supplementary item description to set for the new item.

inputParameters.name: DWNO
inputParameters.description: Drawing number to associate with the new item.

inputParameters.name: RESP
inputParameters.description: User responsible for the item.

inputParameters.name: UNMS
inputParameters.description: Basic unit of measure used to stock and manage the item.

inputParameters.name: ITGR
inputParameters.description: Item group used to classify the item.

inputParameters.name: ITCL
inputParameters.description: Product group used to classify the item.

inputParameters.name: BUAR
inputParameters.description: Business area used for grouping and reporting the item.

inputParameters.name: ITTY
inputParameters.description: Item type that controls lifecycle behavior and defaults for the item.

inputParameters.name: CITT
inputParameters.description: Item type to copy or apply when creating the new item.

inputParameters.name: TPCD
inputParameters.description: Item category classifying the item’s characteristics.

inputParameters.name: MABU
inputParameters.description: Make/buy code indicating whether the item is manufactured or purchased.

inputParameters.name: CHCD
inputParameters.description: Configuration code indicating whether and how the item is configurable.

inputParameters.name: STCD
inputParameters.description: Inventory accounting code indicating whether and how the item is inventory accounted.

inputParameters.name: BACD
inputParameters.description: Lot numbering method used when creating lot numbers for the item.

inputParameters.name: VOL3
inputParameters.description: Volume of one unit of the item.

inputParameters.name: NEWE
inputParameters.description: Net weight of one unit of the item.

inputParameters.name: GRWE
inputParameters.description: Gross weight of one unit of the item including packaging.

inputParameters.name: PPUN
inputParameters.description: Unit of measure in which the purchase price is expressed.

inputParameters.name: BYPR
inputParameters.description: By/co-product code indicating whether the item is a main product, co-product, or by-product.

inputParameters.name: WAPC
inputParameters.description: Normal waste percentage used in planning and costing for the item.

inputParameters.name: QACD
inputParameters.description: Inspection code defining whether and how the item is quality inspected.

inputParameters.name: EPCD
inputParameters.description: Indicates whether yield is calculated for the item when it is prepared as a product.

inputParameters.name: POCY
inputParameters.description: Normal potency percentage used for inventory accounting and planning of the item.

inputParameters.name: ACTI

inputParameters.name: HIE1

inputParameters.name: HIE4

inputParameters.name: HIE5
inputParameters.description: Item hierarchy level 5 value used for grouping and reporting.

inputParameters.name: GRP1

inputParameters.name: GRP2
inputParameters.description: User-defined search group 2 used to group items.

inputParameters.name: GRP3

inputParameters.name: GRP4

inputParameters.name: CFI3
inputParameters.description: User-defined item field 3 for custom classification.

inputParameters.name: CFI5

inputParameters.name: INDI

inputParameters.name: VTCP

inputParameters.name: VTCS

inputParameters.name: GRTS

inputParameters.name: ECVE

inputParameters.name: GRTI

inputParameters.name: CCI1

inputParameters.name: SPGV

inputParameters.name: PDLN

inputParameters.name: CPGR

inputParameters.name: SUME
inputParameters.description: Indicates whether the item is sublot-controlled and how sublots are handled.

inputParameters.name: SUMP

inputParameters.name: QMGP

inputParameters.name: QIRQ

inputParameters.name: SRGR

inputParameters.description: Fragility code used to control how the item is handled and sorted on picking lists.

outputParameters.name: ITNO
outputParameters.description: Item number of the newly created item.

outputParameters.name: HVMT
outputParameters.description: Harvest method set for the newly created item.
